page: Microsoft Azure M128bds_3_v3 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, offering 128 virtual CPUs across 64 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system features a dedicated CPU allocation running at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz, supported by 105 MB of L3 cache. It is equipped with 2794.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 21.83 GB of RAM per physical core. Additionally, the instance includes 6144 GB of local storage and is premium storage capable.

In benchmark evaluations, the M128bds_3_v3 demonstrates top-tier performance in memory bandwidth, achieving 9024.88 GB/sec for cached read-only small blocks and 432.24 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Multi-threaded operations are highly efficient, as evidenced by top-tier results in bzip3 decompression and Passmark database operations. The Intel Xeon processor's advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions), contribute to top-tier scores in Passmark CPU extended instructions and encryption tests. Single-core performance is also strong, with Geekbench single-core scores in the top 10% tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers high resource density, combining massive memory capacity with substantial local storage, which reduces the need for external storage overhead in memory-intensive tasks. However, the lack of dedicated GPU hardware limits its efficiency for heavy deep learning training, though it maintains strong CPU-based LLM inference speeds. This hardware profile is optimized for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, Redis deployments, complex software compilation, and enterprise-grade web serving.
description: Microsoft Azure M128bds_3_v3 is a memory-optimized server from the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family, designed for resource-intensive enterprise workloads. It features an Intel Xeon 8473C x86_64 processor with 128 vCPUs (64 physical cores) running at 4.0 GHz, supported by 2794.0 GB of RAM and 6144 GB of local storage. The instance delivers top-tier performance in memory bandwidth, database operations, and cryptographic execution, aided by Intel AVX-512 and AMX instruction sets. While it lacks GPU acceleration, its massive memory-to-vCPU ratio and high-speed local storage make it highly cost-efficient for large-scale in-memory databases, Redis deployments, and heavy data processing.
